svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
How to create and store Google 2-Step Verification
backup codes before losing your phone
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-07
First, check when backup codes are
needed
Google Help explains that backup codes should be
used if you lose your phone, change your phone
number, or cannot receive codes by text message…
Create a set of codes under Security
and sign-in
Go to your Google Account (myaccount.google.com)
and open the “Security and sign-in” menu.
Remember that each code can be used
only once
Each backup code is eight digits long and is
deactivated after being used for one sign-in.
Store them in a secure place
Google advises printing the codes and storing
them in a safe place where you keep important
documents, such as your passport.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
